- 2026-10-27 · touches · "This first experience is a core third party ready concern." (The generic editor is many people's first experience of SRS, and muSrs must present a coherent view there: data first, tools after (2026-10-27))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "This is a core "Third party ready" requiement." (The spec is not usable online; agents must understand SRS and use it well (2026-10-28))
- 2026-10-28 · touches · "What should I expect of a spec so that I can point an LLM at it and it will understand?" (The spec must be agent readable: that is the point of SRS (2026-10-28))
- 2026-11-03 · touches · "we are making the system accessible to new users" (Readable repositories are third-party-ready work: making the system accessible to new users (2026-11-03))
